record.title: Turkmenistan pandemic foreign-passenger restrictions
record.exceptions: Initial March report excepted diplomats, international-organisation personnel, transport crews and foreign business staff. Freight-carrier procedures subsequently changed; see CC014. Returning-citizen details remain incomplete.
record.enforcement: Contemporary national reporting dates the initial prohibition; a May government report confirms restrictions. Tourism operators later report readmission, with land access confirmed by August 2023.
record.status_observation: Tourist admission reported March 2023; land passage explicitly confirmed by 28 August 2023
record.context: Repeated extensions; tourist re-admission later than freight transit.
record.uncertainty: March 2023 operator notice concerns tourist admission generally; it does not explicitly establish land reopening month. Land access confirmed by 28 August, but exact reopening date unresolved. Related freight-carrier component CC014 is not another independent whole-border event.
